name: Word Wheel
description: "Built for ___" with a 3D drum of words: neighbours sit above and below in perspective, and the drum turns one word at a time with a small wind-up and a settling overshoot; the word on the reading line takes the accent.
move: "Built for ___" with a 3D drum of words: neighbours sit above and below in perspective, and the drum turns one word at a time with a small wind-up and a settling overshoot; the word on the reading line takes the accent.
how: Deterministic draw(t). Words sit on a cylinder (radius from font size so neighbours are one line apart); each is placed with translate3d and rotateX from its angle to the reading line, faded by cos², and coloured accent↔muted by distance. Turns use a true back in-out (zero velocity at both ends) after 0.5s holds.
adapt: Edit the drum words. STEP_DEG sets drum curvature; HOLD/MOVE the rhythm. Placeholder copy is generic. Colours come from the palette tokens at the top of the page (--bg, --surface, --ink, --muted, --accent, --accent-2); change those to re-brand it.
port: Pure draw(t): mount the markup in the shot and call draw from the film's frame hook with shot-local time; wait for fonts before measuring.
caveats: Original implementation of the "Drum / wheel word rotator" motion-design idea; no third-party preset, kit or brand assets.
Starts and ends on its opening frame so it loops; trim the exit when cutting to the next shot.
